verdict.rationale: Expensify claims real-time capture via SmartScan (data extracted 'in realtime, no batch processing') and offers categorization/workspaces, which would support real-time spend visibility by merchant and category, but independent user reports directly contradict the categorization accuracy claim — one reports ~70% miscategorization and use of outsourced human labor (MTurk) rather than reliable automated categorization, undermining the 'by category' promise. Missing for 10: evidence of a real-time company-wide spend dashboard broken down by team/department, and any rebuttal or fix to the categorization accuracy complaints.
